definitions.explanation: a kitchen utensil used for whipping eggs, cream, or mixing ingredients

examples.japanese: {泡立|あわだ}て{器|き}で{卵|たまご}を{混|ま}ぜる。
examples.english: To mix eggs with a whisk.

examples.japanese: メレンゲを{作|つく}るのに{泡立|あわだ}て{器|き}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need a whisk to make meringue.

examples.japanese: {電動|でんどう}{泡立|あわだ}て{器|き}を{使|つか}うと{早|はや}く{泡立|あわだ}てられる。
examples.english: Using an electric whisk allows you to whip things quickly.

notes:
TYPES:
- {手動|しゅどう}{泡立|あわだ}て{器|き} (manual whisk)
- {電動|でんどう}{泡立|あわだ}て{器|き} (electric mixer/hand mixer)

ALTERNATE NAMES:
ホイッパー (whipper) is also commonly used.
